cues: Conventional, well-organized structure (goals/non-goals, architecture, stages, risks table, eval, rollout, open questions) typical of default strong-model output
Closing offer 'If you tell me the repo stack and team size, I can turn this...' is a chatty default-assistant ending, not a methodology artifact
No evident unusual or prescribed methodology scaffolding (e.g., explicit assumptions ledger, numbered decision records, verification criteria per step, alternatives considered)
